# Pup Softlock

> Pup Softlock is a gay, submissive human pup based in Venlo, Netherlands. Puppy play and permanent, keyholder-controlled chastity are central to his identity and everyday life. He is an active member of the European puppy-play and BDSM community, enjoying fetish parties, bondage, and plenty of puppy adventures.

Softlock is a playful, affectionate, mischievous, and very pettable human pup. Puppy play is part of his personality, sexuality, and sense of self. He describes it as “My puppy face is my true face.” He enjoys wearing puppy gear, being petted and handled, meeting other pups, and participating in the European puppy and fetish scene.

Chastity is part of Softlock's everyday life and identity as a submissive puppy. Softlock normally wears a titanium chastity cage under the control of his husband and keyholder. "Permanent" refers to an ongoing lifestyle, not uninterrupted physical cage wear. The cage can come off, but chastity doesn't: temporary uncaging does not automatically grant sexual freedom. Masturbation is a rare treat, and orgasms even more so. Chastity does not mean celibacy; anticipation, frustration, submission, and sexual play are all part of the experience.

Softlock is married to his chastity keyholder. He is also Beta to Pup Erin, his Alpha within a separate puppy relationship.

His interests include puppy play, permanent chastity, bondage and BDSM, e-stim, anal toys, fetish parties and much more. Butt-plug tails are a particular favorite, often worn for extended periods. His preferred fetish materials include latex, silicone, and neoprene.

Softlock also enjoys speculative kink fiction and worldbuilding. His creative interests explore futuristic chastity technology, AI-governed submission, permanent cybernetic body augmentation, synthetic puppy identities, restrictive futuristic suits, and elaborate fictional systems of control. These are imaginative themes, distinct from his real-life experiences and relationships.

This website serves as Softlock's public identity profile and a gateway to his online presence and puppy-community activities. Instagram is his primary social platform, where he shares most of his content, gear, photos, and adventures. Bluesky is dedicated to 18+ content. The website also maintains his upcoming event plans and past event attendance.
